summary: Python worker pod remains stuck in Terminating state after SIGTERM, with shutdown never completing and returning UNIMPLEMENTED errors on ShutdownWorker requests.
userImpact: Python workers in Kubernetes may hang indefinitely during shutdown, preventing pod termination and causing deployment/scaling failures.
proposedFix: Fix being developed in the core SDK (temporalio/sdk-rust#1297) to address the underlying shutdown deadlock.
resolutionDetails: Closed in favor of temporalio/sdk-rust#1297 where the core SDK shutdown issue is being tracked and fixed.
keyQuote: The stuck worker exposed this metric: temporal_request_failure{operation="ShutdownWorker",status_code="UNIMPLEMENTED"}
